prompt: Summarize this in one sentence: A microcontroller reads a temperature sensor once each minute. It turns on a fan when the temperature rises above 30 degrees Celsius and turns the fan off when the temperature falls below 28 degrees Celsius.
response: A microcontroller monitors a temperature sensor, turning on a fan when the temperature rises above 30 degrees Celsius and turning it off when the temperature falls below 28 degrees Celsius.
